claims.claim: a pair of loons rearing two chicks removes about 423 kg of food over 5.5 months
territories average about 72 ha in Wisconsin, where food may limit them

claims.claim: loons mostly take whatever fish is easiest to catch, "often yellow perch"; loons do not appear to harm sport fisheries
Barr's total implies about 1.1 kg a day per adult, 20–25 % of body mass (project arithmetic)
claims.note: the input (423 kg) is unchecked. The arithmetic holds: 423 kg / ~167 d = 2.53 kg/d per family; less two chicks at 0.16–0.38 kg/d for ~84 d (27–64 kg) leaves 1.07–1.18 kg/d per adult, 22–27 % of a 4–5-kg bird
